verdict.rationale: The pack documents CloudFormation templates and CDK infrastructure-as-code that provision and update resources, plus CLI command history. It shows no AWS-native capability to version automations, review changes before applying them, or roll back to a prior version. Keeping CDK code in git would be a user-side workaround, and stack deletion and CLI history are adjacent features, not versioning, review, or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
